about.story_h3: Who We Are and Who We Work With
about.story_p1: GVA Verkaufer was founded in 2018 with a clear objective: to become the preferred automotive logistics partner for companies that move large volumes of vehicles.
about.story_p2: Our business model is based on full loads — minimum 8–9 vehicles per trip. A full platform means optimal cost per unit for our partner and maximum efficiency for us.
about.values_h3: What Sets Us Apart as a B2B Partner
about.v1_text: A full platform means the best cost per unit for our partner. Every trip is planned for maximum efficiency in both directions.
about.v2_text: We work on a contract basis with fixed prices, clear deadlines and a set schedule. No price surprises, no unexplained delays.
about.v3_text: Every vehicle is professionally secured and CMR-insured for the entire transport duration. We have recorded zero damages since 2018.
about.v4_text: Our clients become recurring partners. We adapt capacity, routes and schedule around their operational needs — long term.
about.team_p: The GVA Verkaufer team brings together drivers experienced on vehicle transport platforms and an operations department that manages the planning of loads, routes and documentation.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: General terms and conditions applicable to B2B automotive transport services offered by GVA Verkaufer.
terms.scope_body: These general terms regulate the contractual relationship between GVA Verkaufer ("Provider") and legal entities ("Partner") for vehicle platform transport services. Service provision is conditional on full acceptance of these terms. Any deviation must be agreed in writing.
terms.booking_body: Orders are submitted by email or web form and confirmed by the Provider within a maximum of 4 business hours. The Provider's written confirmation constitutes the moment of contract conclusion for each transport. Load changes (vehicle count, origin, destination) communicated at least 24h before loading are accepted without penalty.
terms.payment_body: Rates are established contractually and remain fixed for the duration of the contract. Invoicing is done post-transport with a 30-day payment term from the invoice date. Late payment attracts penalties of 0.1% per day on the outstanding amount, not exceeding the invoice value.
terms.liability_body: Every vehicle is CMR-insured for the entire duration of transport. The Provider's liability is limited to the declared value of the vehicle at collection. Damages are recorded in the handover document signed by both parties. Damage claims must be submitted within 48h of delivery.
terms.force_majeure_body: Neither party is liable for failure to fulfil obligations caused by force majeure events (natural disasters, conflicts, legal restrictions, etc.). The invoking party notifies the other within 24h. Execution deadlines are extended by the duration of the force majeure event.
terms.law_body: This contract is governed by Romanian law. Disputes are resolved amicably. In the absence of an amicable agreement, jurisdiction belongs to the courts of Romania. These terms may be modified at any time; the current version is published on the website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information regarding the processing of personal data in accordance with GDPR (EU) 2016/679.
privacy.intro_body: GVA Verkaufer, headquartered in Romania, is the controller of your personal data. You may contact us at auto@gvaverkaufer.ro or +40 745 852 977 for any personal data request.
privacy.collected_body: We collect data necessary for service delivery: name, email, phone, company name, tax number and transport lot details. We do not collect special categories of personal data (biometric, medical, etc.). Data is provided directly by you through the contact form or email.
privacy.purpose_body: Data is processed exclusively for: issuing and executing transport contracts, invoicing, commercial communication about our services and compliance with legal obligations. We do not sell or share your data with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.
privacy.retention_body: Contractual and billing data is retained for 10 years in accordance with tax and accounting obligations. Marketing data is deleted upon request or after 3 years of inactivity. Upon request, you may ask for the deletion of non-mandatory data.
privacy.rights_body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection to the processing of your data. You may exercise these rights by email at auto@gvaverkaufer.ro. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
privacy.security_body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data: restricted access, encrypted transmission, secure storage. Security incidents are notified to the competent authority and affected persons in accordance with GDPR requirements.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Information about the use of cookies on the GVA Verkaufer website.
cookies.what_body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when visiting a website. They are used for the proper functioning of the website, storing preferences and traffic analysis. They do not contain personally identifiable information and cannot access other files on your device.
cookies.essential_body: These cookies are necessary for the basic functioning of the website and cannot be disabled. They store the language preference (gva-lang) and browsing session. They do not collect tracking data. Duration: session or maximum 1 year.
cookies.analytics_body: We use anonymised analytics data to understand visitor behaviour and improve the website. This data does not identify individual users. You can refuse analytics cookies without affecting the essential functionalities of the website.
cookies.manage_body: You can control and delete cookies from your browser settings. Detailed instructions are available in browser documentation (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). Deleting cookies may affect your language preference and other saved settings.
cookies.contact_body: For questions regarding the use of cookies or the privacy policy, please contact us at auto@gvaverkaufer.ro. We respond to requests within a maximum of 2 business days.
